description: The Margin agent configs pin the model and Claude Code version in lockstep for A/B validity (per evals/margin/CLAUDE.md): baseline-sonnet (control) and tether-sonnet (treatment) must pin the same claude_version and the same model in both startup_args and settings_json (currently claude-sonnet-4-6 / Claude Code 2.1.167). Bumping one arm's pins without the other makes the comparison diverge on model/version rather than on tether.
